info.title: InvoiceFlow API
info.description: InvoiceFlow public API. Authenticate with an API key (`x-api-key` header or `Authorization: Bearer ivfk_…`) or an OAuth2 client-credentials access token. Every error is `{error, message}`; `402 license_required` means the firm's InvoiceFlow subscription is not active. See docs/api.md for pagination, idempotency keys, rate limits and webhooks.

post.description:
RFC 6749 §4.4: ``grant_type=client_credentials`` with the API key as client id/secret
(form body, HTTP Basic, or JSON). Returns a bearer token valid for ``API_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS``.
